commands.name: onboard
commands.description: Deterministic onboarding draft/status/interactive/complete workflow for generated product repos.

options.name: --repo-root
options.description: Repo root (default: cwd).

options.name: --resume
options.description: Resume an embedded-handoff onboarding run by id. SignalOS reads the agent-produced artifacts at the canonical .signalos/* paths, validates each against its onboarding-surface contract, writes per-artifact REPAIR_TASK files on failure (exit 9, up to 3 cycles, then exit 8), and emits one skill-invoked audit event per validated artifact on full pass.

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Begin the adaptive onboarding walkthrough. Writes .signalos/onboarding-walkthrough.in-progress marker and points the agent at the onboarding-walkthrough skill (Stream B-Onboarding instance).

options.name: --complete
options.description: Verify every MUST onboarding topic (O-1..O-N) has a covering row in .signalos/onboarding-coverage.jsonl. Invokes scripts/audit-onboarding-coverage.sh and forwards its exit code. On exit 0, writes .signalos/onboarding-complete.marker and removes the in-progress marker.

commands.name: draft
commands.description: Hand off the 10 onboarding artifacts to the host coding agent. SignalOS writes per-artifact AGENT_TASK packets under .signalos/agent-runs/<runId>/onboarding/ and exits 9 so the host coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Goose, Aider, ...) drafts every artifact with its own LLM. The user then resumes with `signalos-net onboard --resume <runId>` for SignalOS to validate each artifact and record one skill-invoked audit event per artifact. PO signing remains manual. v2.0: no skeleton-stub fallback - the agent does all real drafting.
